form.title: REAL ESTATE LISTING AGREEMENT

field.label: Listing Type
field.options: Exclusive Right to Sell, Exclusive Agency

form.section: This contract is between the property Owner and Culebraluxe LLC, represented by Lisa Penfield, Puerto Rico Real Estate Broker #9931. The term "Owner" refers to , of legal age, , with residence at . The Owner holds title to the property known as , located at , Catastro Number , hereinafter referred to as the "Property." The party of the second part, Culebraluxe LLC, represented by Broker , is hereinafter referred to as the "Broker," Puerto Rico Real Estate Broker License #9931, with mailing address P.O. Box 737, Culebra, PR 00775. In consideration of the services to be provided by the Broker, the Owner grants the Broker the listing authority to market, show, and sell the Property. This Agreement is a simple partnership to sell your property with confidence. The Broker handles the marketing, showings, offers, and closing, keeping you informed throughout the process to create a successful sale of your property.

The Property will be pre-qualified as ready to sell by Broker. Owner will furnish all documentation pertaining to the Property to the Broker, including the current deed. Broker will pre-qualify the Property as legally able to be sold according to the public records. If the Property has obstacles to sale, the Broker will advise the Owner of the steps that need to be taken to pre-qualify the Property.
The Property will be evaluated by the Broker for needed attention, such as updates to curb appeal, addressing neglected maintenance, etc.
The Broker will provide a Broker Opinion of Value report (BOV).

Minimal staging and a full portfolio of quality still photography, accurate descriptions, and accurate details and parameters of the Property will be produced by the Broker. Qualitative property-enhancement details will be presented to buyers by the Broker, such as distance to beaches, swimming, restaurants and bars, sunrise views, dock access, shops, tranquility of the neighborhood, nice neighbors, good prevailing winds, etc. A property "story" will be created by the Broker with input from the Owner.

We are tech-savvy and have a custom, code-based bespoke website. We are not using a template. We leverage AI to push your property across every platform at once. That strategic edge is what turns into real-world results - showings, offers, and a closed sale.
In the case of unique properties, we micro-target buyers and investors who are well suited for the product - your property and its features and benefits.
We negotiate with buyers regarding offers, counteroffers, and acceptable concessions for the sale in order to arrive at an acceptable sales price.

Broker will prepare, at the Broker's cost, photos, property descriptions, web pages, website placement across major websites, and other steps and activities agreed to by Broker and Owner to actively market the Property.

Broker will market on multiple Internet sites wholly owned by the Broker; public advertising sites such as Zillow.com, ClasificadosOnline.com, Trulia.com, Facebook.com, Puerto Rico MLS; Internet sites of other Realtors; and any other sites deemed advantageous for advertising by either the Broker or Owner.
Broker will coordinate appointments for surveyors, appraisers, and inspectors on an as-needed basis to best position the Property in the highest light possible.
Local Broker will coordinate a POA from Owner in order to provide representation at CRIM, the Department of Hacienda, and the IRS to coordinate paperwork required for the closing statements.
Broker can recommend closing attorneys and any other professionals that may be needed in order to facilitate a swift closing.
Broker can represent Owner at the closing with a legal POA paid for by the Owner.
Broker can recommend tax experts to address capital gains taxes and other liabilities.

The asking price for the Property will be . The asking price will be approved by the Owner with the educated advice and comparison data provided by the Broker. It may be advisable to obtain a private appraisal.
In the event that an offer is accepted and a sale is closed, Owner agrees to pay Broker a commission of . In a co-booking situation, the commission will be shared equally with the other broker.
Owner and Broker understand that any commission paid is not set by law or regulation.

Commission shall be paid at the time of closing, even if the closing occurs after the term of this Agreement has expired, for up to one year after expiration, provided that Broker showed the Property to the Buyer, or a party related to the Buyer, before this Agreement expired, including the Buyer's company, partner, or spouse.
It is the Owner's responsibility to cooperate with the Broker and provide any information needed to facilitate the sale of the Property.
It is the Broker's responsibility to obtain from the Owner all information needed to properly market and sell the Property.
Cleaning and staging fees may apply and must be approved by the Owner.
The Property will be maintained in a presentable condition for proper showings.
Broker will pre-qualify the Buyer and coordinate showings with the Owner or property representative.

Any funds delivered by a potential Buyer to the Broker will be deposited in escrow by the Broker in an escrow account registered with the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico and will be available at the time of closing.

In the event a potential Buyer's escrow deposit is forfeited for noncompliance, said deposit will be shared by the Broker and the Owner 50/50, provided that the Broker's 50% does not exceed the contracted commission amount. If 50% exceeds the contracted commission amount, the Broker's payment shall be limited to the contracted commission amount.

Properties on Culebra are often sold as second homes, which can take a year to sell if priced at the top of the market. This Agreement shall be effective beginning and shall expire on . One month before expiration of this Agreement, if the Owner is satisfied with the marketing, showings, and communication, the Agreement may be extended for a mutually agreed-upon period.
An upgraded media package featuring drone photography and video embedded in the listing is available for a fee of $500. This media fee will be subtracted at closing.
Signage will be placed on the Property with the Owner's approval.
If the Owner takes the Property off the market during the contract term, the Broker will be paid $600 for out-of-pocket expenses.

If the Owner receives and refuses, in writing, a bona fide offer for the agreed-upon asking price of and thereafter terminates or circumvents this Agreement in order to sell the Property independently, Broker shall be entitled to 60% of the commission that would have been payable to Broker upon the sale of the Property.
